questions.question: Which type of encryption protects data stored in database files, logs, and backups?

explanations.a: Column-level encryption secures only specific columns.
explanations.b: Network encryption protects data during transmission.
explanations.c: TDE encrypts database files, logs, and backups automatically.
explanations.d: Application-level encryption is handled outside the database.

questions.question: At which level does Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) operate?

explanations.a: Column-level encryption works on individual columns.
explanations.b: Row-level encryption is not used in TDE.
explanations.c: TDE operates at the database storage level.
explanations.d: Network-level encryption protects data in transit.

questions.question: Which of the following actions requires decryption of encrypted data?

answers.a: Storing encrypted data in the database
answers.c: Reading sensitive data by an authorized user

explanations.c: Authorized users must decrypt data to read it.
explanations.d: Encryption occurs before data is stored.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of database encryption?

answers.d: Protection of data stored on disk

explanations.c: Encryption does not improve database performance.

questions.question: Why is column-level encryption considered a fine-grained security technique?

answers.a: It encrypts the entire database automatically
answers.b: It encrypts only selected sensitive columns

explanations.a: This describes TDE, not column-level encryption.
explanations.b: Column-level encryption targets specific sensitive columns.
explanations.c: Network encryption protects data in transit.
explanations.d: Backup encryption is part of TDE.

questions.question: Which factor is essential to ensure the effectiveness of database encryption?

explanations.a: Database size does not affect encryption effectiveness.
explanations.b: Network bandwidth is unrelated to encryption security.
explanations.c: Secure key management is critical for encryption and decryption.
explanations.d: Indexing does not improve encryption security.
